title: Mobile app engagement and effective weight management
core_idea: Investigate whether engagement with a mobile app during a 36-day virtual competition is associated with lifestyle outcomes—specifically physical activity and dietary habits—aimed at increasing activity and adherence to a plant-based, whole-food diet, via secondary analysis of the Thaisook prospective cohort and comparing high- versus low-engagement users (>50% vs <50% of challenge days).
tldr: Assess the relationship between mobile app engagement and changes in physical activity and diet during a 36-day virtual health challenge using secondary cohort data; participants are grouped by high or low app engagement.
